sourceFiles.note: Fuel-powered motorcycle inventory. Creates opening stock.
Spiro electric motorcycle inventory. Creates opening stock.

classificationNotice: Categories and compatibility are derived from the source workbooks: fuel_powered_moto_spare_parts.xlsx is FUEL-POWERED and Spiro_Garage_Spare_Parts_Inventory.xlsx is SPIRO ELECTRIC. An Ampersand workbook follows the same rule as AMPERSAND ELECTRIC when supplied.
priceNotice: The workbook sell price is the confirmed customer price and is published on the storefront. Rows without a sell price stay PRICE NEEDS REVIEW. Rows whose sell price is below purchase cost are flagged for BOSS review without changing the source value.
